description: A painted interior scene under a timber and palm-thatch roof, with mud-brick walls and palm trunks behind. Sunlight shafts in from above. A bearded man in a brown robe and headwrap kneels and clasps the hand of a white-bearded elder in a cream robe, who sits on a rug. Around them about a dozen men in robes and headwraps sit or stand, some gesturing. No text, frame or gore is visible; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
